title: Chromatic Counting, Deletion-Contraction, and the Sharpness of the Greedy Bound
description: A machine-checked development of the chromatic counting function with closed forms on edgeless and complete graphs, the additive deletion-contraction identity, and the greedy bound chi(G) <= Delta(G)+1, proved tight exactly on the two Brooks exception families (complete graphs and odd cycles).
key_results: colorable_maxDegree_add_one: every finite graph is (maxDegree+1)-colorable (greedy bound)
